arguments.name: Lib
arguments.description: Lib to release. Can be either name in default location or  fully rooted path

options.name: --ApiKey
options.description: nuget.org api key for pushing packages to nuget.org. Can  also be set as environment variable: NUGET_API_KEY. Explicit ApiKey set  overrules Environment variable

options.name: --debug
options.description: Sets LogLevel to Debug. Debug overrides LogLevel if set.

options.name: --pause
options.description: Pauses execution at start to wait for debugger attach.  Wait times out if no key is pressed.

options.name: --verbose
options.description: Sets LogLevel to Trace. Verbose overrides LogLevel and  Debug if set.
